references.text: Ephraim was the son of Joseph, and here his birth in Egypt is mentioned as the ancestor of the tribe of Ephraim.
Jacob adopted Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons, which gave Ephraim the status of one of the tribes of Israel.
Jacob blessed Ephraim over Manasseh and prophesied that Ephraim would become greater than his brother.
The tribe of Ephraim and their position in the camp are mentioned here with the same number of men as in the census.
The second census of the tribe of Ephraim shows 32,500 men, a decrease from the first count.
Moses' blessing over Joseph/Ephraim describes the strength and power of the tribe.
